01

“so let there be no distress in your heart because of it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hasan informed us, saying: Ibrahim ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali related to us, saying: Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Warqa ibn Umar related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
so let there be no distress in your heart because of it [al-Araf 2] meaning: "doubt about it."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَلَا يَكُنْ فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِنْهُ [الأعراف: 2] يَعْنِي: «شَكًّا مِنْهُ»
Edition record 372167 · p. 333Link to report ↗
02

“And the weighing that Day will be the truth”

An explanation transmitted from ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr al-Laythī (Q 7:8).

02
Explanation from ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr 02

ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr al-Laythī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Ubayd ibn Umayr al-Laythi, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
And the weighing that Day will be the truth [al-Araf 8], he said: "A huge, tall man who eats and drinks much will be brought, and he will not weigh the wing of a gnat with God."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ [الأعراف: 8] ، قَالَ: «يُؤْتَى بِالرَّجُلِ الْعَظِيمِ الطَّوِيلِ الْأَكُولِ الشَّرُوبِ فَلَا يَزِنُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ»
Edition record 372168 · p. 333Link to report ↗
03

“And We have certainly created you”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:11).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And We have certainly created you [al-Araf 11] meaning: "the creation of Adam"; then We fashioned you [al-Araf 11] meaning: "in the loins of Adam ﷺ."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ [الأعراف: 11] يَعْنِي: «خَلَقَ آدَمَ» ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ [الأعراف: 11] يَعْنِي: «فِي ظَهْرِ آدَمَ عليه السلام»
Edition record 372169 · p. 333Link to report ↗
04

“I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:16).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path [al-Araf 16], he said: "He means Islam, the true religion."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ [الأعراف: 16] ، قَالَ: " يَعْنِي الْإِسْلَامَ: الدِّينَ الْحَقَّ "
Edition record 372170 · p. 333Link to report ↗
05

“Then I will come to them from before them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:17).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Then I will come to them from before them [al-Araf 17] meaning from where they can see, and from behind them [al-Araf 17] meaning: from where they cannot see.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ
ثُمَّ لَآتِيَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ [الأعراف: 17] يَعْنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ يُبْصِرُونَ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ [الأعراف: 17] يَعْنِي: مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
Edition record 372171 · p. 334Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

"Get out of it, disgraced" meaning: "banished"; and expelled [al-Araf 18] meaning: "driven away."
العربية
الإسناد

اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذءُومًا يَعْنِي: «مَنْفِيًّا» مَدْحُورًا [الأعراف: 18] يَعْنِي: «مَطْرُودًا»

08

Further reports

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
"We have bestowed upon you clothing to cover your private parts" he said: "Some of the Arabs used to circumambulate the House naked, so they were commanded to wear clothing."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْآتِكُمْ قَالَ: «كَانَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ يَطُوفُونَ بِالْبَيْتِ، عُرَاةً فَأُمِرُوا بِاللِّبَاسِ»
Edition record 372174 · p. 334Link to report ↗
09
Report from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

"Finery [riyash] is wealth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الرِّيَاشُ: الْمَالُ "

09

“Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:27).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn ⦗p. 335⦘ Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe [al-Araf 27] he said: "His tribe: the jinn and the devils."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ ⦗ص: 335⦘ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِنَّهُ يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ [الأعراف: 27] قَالَ: " قَبِيلُهُ: الْجِنُّ وَالشَّيَاطِينُ "

10

“and set your faces [right] at every place of prostration”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:29, 7:30).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and set your faces [right] at every place of prostration [al-Araf 29] He says: "Direct your faces at every mosque toward the Kaba, wherever you pray, in a church or elsewhere."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأَقِيمُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ [الأعراف: 29] يَقُولُ: «اجْعَلُوا وجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ حَيْثُمَا صَلَّيْتُمْ فِي كَنِيسَةٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهَا»
Edition record 372177 · p. 335Link to report ↗
12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
As He originated you, you will return [al-Araf 29], a group He guided and a group upon whom error was justified [al-Araf 30] meaning: "the wretched and the fortunate."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ [الأعراف: 29] ، فَرِيقًا هَدَى وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلَالَةَ [الأعراف: 30] يَعْنِي: «شَقِيًّا وَسَعِيدًا»
Edition record 372178 · p. 335Link to report ↗
11

“Take your adornment at every place of prostration”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:31).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Take your adornment at every place of prostration [al-Araf 31] meaning by it: "Quraysh, because they left off clothing during the circumambulation."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ [الأعراف: 31] يَعْنِي بِهِ: «قُرَيْشًا لِتَرْكِهَا الثِّيَابَ فِي الطَّوَافِ»

12

“Their portion of the Decree will reach them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:37).

14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Their portion of the Decree will reach them [al-Araf 37] he said: "of wretchedness and happiness, like His words: among them is the wretched [Hud 105] and the fortunate."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُمْ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ [الأعراف: 37] قَالَ: " مِنَ الشَّقَاءِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ: فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ [هود: 105] وَسَعِيدٌ "

15

“until the camel [jamal] passes”

Four explanations transmitted from Abū al-ʿĀliya al-Riyāḥī and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:40).

17
Explanation from Abū al-ʿĀliya 17

Abū al-ʿĀliya al-Riyāḥī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Zayd related to us, from Shuayb ibn al-Habhab, from Abu al-Aliya al-Riyahi, on His words:
until the camel [jamal] passes [al-Araf 40], he said: "It is the camel with four legs, and he used to recite it: al-jamal."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الرِّيَاحِيِّ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ [الأعراف: 40] ، قَالَ: " هُوَ الْجَمَلُ الَّذِي عَلَى أَرْبَعِ قَوَائِمَ وَكَانَ يَقْرَؤُهَا: الُجُّمَّلُ "
Edition record 372183 · p. 336Link to report ↗
18
Report from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"It is the rope of the ship [jummal]."
العربية

Report 20

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Mashar related to us, saying: Yahya ibn Shibl related to us, from Yahya ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Madani, from his father, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ was asked about the people of the Heights (al-Araf), and he said: "They are people who were killed in the cause of God, Mighty and Majestic, while disobeying their fathers. Their disobedience of them kept them from entering Paradise, and their being killed in the cause of God kept them from the Fire."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ: نا يَحْيَى بْنُ شِبْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَدَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ، عَنْ أَصْحَابِ الْأَعْرَافِ فَقَالَ:
«هُمْ نَاسٌ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل فِي مَعْصِيَةِ آبَائِهِمْ، مَنَعَهُمْ مِنْ دُخُولِ الْجَنَّةِ مَعْصِيَتُهُمْ إِيَّاهُمْ، وَمَنَعَهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ قَتْلُهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

الإسناد

أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا [الأعراف: 129] يَعْنُونَ: «قَبْلَ إِرْسَالِ اللَّهِ إِيَّاكَ وَبَعْدَهُ»
Edition record 372208 · p. 341Link to report ↗
43
Explanation from Wahb ibn Munabbih 43

Wahb ibn Munabbih

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, saying: Abu Sinan related to us, from Wahb ibn Munabbih, on His words:
They said, 'We were harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us' [al-Araf 129] he said: "The Children of Israel said to Moses: 'O Moses, Pharaoh used to make us make bricks and give us straw before; when you came to us, he made us make bricks and supply the straw as well.' Moses said: 'My Lord, destroy Pharaoh; until when will You keep him?' So it was revealed to him: 'O Moses, they have not yet done the deed for which I will destroy them.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: نا أَبُو سِنَانٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَالُوا أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا [الأعراف: 129] قَالَ: " قَالَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ لِمُوسَى يَا مُوسَى، إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ كَانَ يُكَلِّفُنَا اللَّبَنَ وَيُعْطِينَا التِّبْنَ قَبْلُ، فَلَمَّا جِئْتَنَا كُلِّفْنَا اللَّبَنَ مَعَ التِّبْنِ وَقَالَ مُوسَى: يَا رَبِّ أَهْلِكْ فِرْعَوْنَ، حَتَّى مَتَى تُبْقِيهِ؟ فَأُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِ يَا مُوسَى، إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَعْمَلُوا الْعَمَلَ الَّذِي أُهْلِكُهُمْ بِهِ بَعْدُ "

English

46

“the day of their Sabbath, when their fish came to them openly, and…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 7:163, 7:166).

57
Explanation from Mujāhid 57

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
the day of their Sabbath, when their fish came to them openly, and the day they did not observe the Sabbath [al-Araf 163] he said: "Fish were forbidden to them on the Sabbath, and they would come to them openly on the Sabbath, a trial with which they were tried, and would not come to them on other days unless they sought them out, also a trial, because they were defiantly disobedient [al-Araf 163]. So they took them on the Sabbath, treating it as lawful and disobeying God, Mighty and Majestic. Then God, Mighty and Majestic, said: Be apes, despised [al-Araf 166], except for a group among them who did not transgress and who forbade them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ [الأعراف: 163] قَالَ: " حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحِيتَانُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ فَكَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ شُرَّعًا، بَلَاءً ابْتُلُوا بِهِ، وَلَا تَأْتِيهِمْ فِي غَيْرِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَطْلُبُوهَا، بَلَاءً أَيْضًا، بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ [الأعراف: 163] فَأَخَذُوهَا يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ اسْتِحْلَالًا وَمَعْصِيَةً لِلَّهِ عز وجل، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: كُونُوا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ [الأعراف: 166] إِلَّا طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ لَمْ يَعْتَدُوا وَنَهَوْهُمْ
Edition record 372223 · p. 345Link to report ↗

“And recite to them the news of him to whom We gave Our signs, but he…”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 7:175).

63
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 63

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Jabir, from Mujahid and Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
And recite to them the news of him to whom We gave Our signs, but he detached himself from them [al-Araf 175] he said: "He is Balam ibn Baur, who was among the Children of Israel. He was given a book and detached ⦗p. 347⦘ himself from it, inclined to the desires and pleasures of this world, and did not benefit from the book he was given." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: he said: "He is Balam ibn Baur from the Children of Israel."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي آتَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْهَا [الأعراف: 175] قَالَ: «هُوَ بِلْعَامُ بْنُ بَاعِرٍ، وَكَانَ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، أُوتِيَ كِتَابًا فَانْسَلَخَ ⦗ص: 347⦘ مِنْهُ فَأَخْلَدَ إِلَى شَهَوَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَذَّاتِهَا، وَلَمْ يَنْتَفِعْ بِمَا أُعْطِيَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ» أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «هُوَ بِلْعَامُ بْنُ بَاعِرٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ»

75
Explanation from Mujāhid 75

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"The Messenger of God ﷺ was praying and heard the recitation of a young man of the Ansar, so there was revealed: 'And when the Quran is recited, listen to it and be silent [al-Araf 204]." He did not consider remembrance [of God] objectionable.

الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَسَمِعَ قِرَاءَةَ فَتًى مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَنَزَلَ وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنْصِتُوا [الأعراف: 204] «فَكَانَ لَا يَرَى بِالذِّكْرِ بَأْسًا»
